summary:
NeuraX Reimagined is our idea for making health monitoring in space smarter and more accessible. We have brought together three proposed technologies: MissionBand, a wearable band designed to monitor health; AstroBone Scanner, which focuses on bone health; and AstraImmune Space Monitor, which focuses on immune health. Through our interactive website, we introduce these ideas, show their features, and explain how they could work together to help monitor astronauts during space missions.

Space can be tough on the human body, especially because of microgravity and the changes astronauts experience while living in space. This makes regular health monitoring very important. With NeuraX Reimagined, we wanted to explore how technology could help astronauts better understand and keep track of their health. Our project combines creative ideas, digital design, and interactive demonstrations to present a possible approach to making future space missions safer and healthier.
details:
NeuraX Reimagined is a space-health technology concept that explores how technology could help astronauts monitor their health during space missions. Our project brings together three proposed devices: MissionBand, a wearable designed for health monitoring; AstroBone Scanner, which focuses on bone health; and AstraImmune Space Monitor, which focuses on immune health.

We developed an interactive website to present these concepts and demonstrate their intended features. Each device has its own section where visitors can explore its purpose and how it could contribute to astronaut health monitoring. The three concepts are designed to work together as part of one connected system.

Our project focuses on the challenges astronauts face in space, particularly the effects of microgravity on the human body. We hope our ideas can encourage further innovation in space healthcare and contribute to making future missions safer.

We used HTML, CSS and JavaScript to develop the website, along with GSAP for animations. We worked with the Antigravity development environment and used digital design tools to create the visual experience. Our website is hosted at neuraxreimagined.earth.

What makes NeuraX Reimagined creative is the way it brings three different health-monitoring concepts together in one connected platform. We considered usability, visual design, accessibility and the importance of presenting our concepts clearly. Our project is a proposed technology concept rather than a fully developed medical device.
